problemsection.part1body: Despite understanding some English, speaking clearly in daily life or at work can still feel stressful or uncertain.
problemsection.part2body: With busy working hours and changing schedules, finding time to attend classes or stay consistent with learning can be difficult.
problemsection.part3body: Many learning tools focus on exams or formal English, making it hard to apply what’s learned to real conversations and everyday situations.
problemsection.subtitle: THE CHALLENGE
problemsection.title: Learning English takes time and support.

faq.a1: The LINK Project helps migrant workers in Singapore learn English for daily life, through short lessons and an AI speaking tutor.
faq.q3: How can I contribute towards the LINK Project?
faq.a3: You can contact us with your ideas, suggestions or questions, and tell us what you would like to see.
faq.q4: Will the LINK Project be free?
faq.a4: Yes, the LINK Project is completely free and no payment will be required.
faq.q5: What kind of support does the LINK Project provide?
faq.a5: The LINK Project gives you free short lessons for daily life and work, an AI tutor to practise speaking in your language, and LINK Assistant for your English questions.

ethics.title: Ethics of AI
ethics.cardGoal: Sort the cards, then match the reasons.
ethics.introBody: Read the words together. Tap Start when your team is ready. The clock starts.
ethics.round1Hint: Who is helped? Who could be hurt? Read the card out loud, decide as a team, then tap.
ethics.recapBody: Talk it through as a team: why is each one good, or a problem?
ethics.round2Hint: Tap a situation, then tap the reason that explains it. Some reasons are good, some are problems.
ethics.showTeacher: Compare this screen with the other team.
ethics.stemProblem: AI is a problem because it …
ethics.playAgainBody: Your time and score will be cleared. Compare them with the other team first.
ethics.round3Hint: Every sentence starts with one of the two stems. Tap the words in order. Two words do not belong.
ethics.buildPlaceholder: Tap the words to make the sentence
ethics.round4Hint: Both sides are possible. Ethics is choosing, and saying why.
ethics.dilemmaSay: Say why out loud. Start with: "We chose this because …"
ethics.takeHomeLead: Ethics means thinking about people before you use a tool. Ask the three questions.
